sources.title: IRS Publication 551, Basis of Assets
claims: The IRS says taxpayers should keep accurate records of items that affect basis; basis of property purchased is usually its cost, but individual facts and tax rules determine application.
The article does not determine the tax classification or reporting of bullion transactions and directs readers to current IRS guidance and a qualified tax professional.

status: Current IRS Publication 551 checked September24; factual scope limited to recordkeeping and general basis language, with no personalized tax conclusion.
